comparison.note: The primary arms are not gateway-only: direct Groq is compared with OpenRouter routing to the cheapest eligible endpoint of the same model, and OpenRouter chooses that endpoint. The controlled arm pins OpenRouter to its Groq endpoint with fallbacks disabled, isolating the gateway for the same model and endpoint.

providers.label: Groq · GroqCloud
providers.routingLabel: direct to GroqCloud; no gateway in between
providers.pricing: Groq production price, read 2026-11-23: $0.15 input / $0.075 cached input / $0.60 output per 1M tokens; 131,072 context; 65,536 max completion; strict json_schema supported.

providers.label: OpenRouter · cheapest eligible endpoint
providers.routingLabel: OpenRouter price-sorted routing over same-model endpoints with fallbacks allowed; the serving endpoint is unspecified until the response reports it
providers.pricing: OpenRouter standard pay-as-you-go, read 2026-11-23: no inference markup; cheapest standard endpoints for this model $0.03 input / $0.15 output per 1M, dearest listed $0.35 / $0.95. Billed at the selected endpoint and settled from usage.cost.

providers.label: OpenRouter · pinned to Groq
providers.routingLabel: OpenRouter pinned to its Groq endpoint (provider.only=["Groq"]) with fallbacks disabled; a response served by any other endpoint is refused
providers.pricing: OpenRouter pinned to Groq with fallbacks off, read 2026-11-23: the endpoint is Groq's own $0.15 input / $0.075 cached input / $0.60 output per 1M. OpenRouter charges no inference markup for it; its 5.5% credit-purchase fee is paid at top-up, not per call, and is recorded separately.
